MapGroupProtoFile.description: MapGroupProtoFile defines reusable building and cluster prototypes for loot placement, including containers, spawn points, and prototype defaults.

cluster.description: ClusterGroups defines reusable groups of nearby objects and their loot containers.

clusters.description: Clusters maps terrain model shapes to logical cluster prototype names.

defaults.description: Defaults provides shared property values inherited by prototypes that do not specify those values directly.

group.description: Groups defines building prototypes and their lootable containers.

prototype.description: XMLName identifies the required `<prototype>` document root.

MapPrototypeContainer.description: MapPrototypeContainer defines one lootable part of a building prototype and the spawn points available within it.

category.description: Categories restrict which item categories can select this container.

lootmax.description: LootMax caps how many items CE may spawn in this container. Each spawn point can hold at most one item.

name.description: Name is the container identifier used by the building's game model.

point.description: Points are the individual positions where CE can place one loot item.

tag.description: Tags restrict which item tags can select this container.

usage.description: Usages restrict which item usage filters can select this container.

value.description: Values restrict which item value tiers can select this container.

MapPrototypeDE.description: MapPrototypeDE links a prototype to a named dynamic-event trajectory.

name.description: Name is the trajectory identifier used by the dynamic-event system.

MapPrototypeDefault.description: MapPrototypeDefault sets one shared property for a prototype category.

de.description: DE names the dynamic-event trajectory associated with the prototype.

enabled.description: Enabled turns the selected default behavior on or off.

height.description: Height sets the height of a generated cluster matrix.

lootmax.description: LootMax is the default maximum amount of loot used for matching groups or containers.

name.description: Name identifies the prototype category or class this default applies to.

width.description: Width sets the width of a generated cluster matrix.

MapPrototypeDefaults.description: MapPrototypeDefaults stores values inherited by map-group or cluster prototypes when their own entries omit those properties.

default.description: Defaults are shared defaults applied to matching prototype entries.

MapPrototypeDispatch.description: MapPrototypeDispatch defines the chance and proxy objects for one dynamic event dispatch from a prototype.

dechance.description: DEChance is the probability that CE dispatches this dynamic event.

proxy.description: Proxies are the objects created by the dispatch, with positions and rotations relative to the prototype.

MapPrototypeEntry.description: MapPrototypeEntry defines one building group or cluster prototype: its loot limits, spawn filters, containers, and optional dynamic-event dispatches.

category.description: Categories restrict which loot categories can use this group.

container.description: Containers define lootable spaces and spawn points within the group.

de.description: DELinks associate this prototype with dynamic-event trajectory presets.

dispatch.description: Dispatches define optional objects created through a dynamic event at this prototype.

lootmax.description: LootMax caps the total loot spawned in this group.

maxinstances.description: MaxInstances caps how many instances of this cluster prototype can be used across the map.

name.description: Name is the prototype identifier used by map instances or cluster data.

tag.description: Tags restrict which loot tags can use this group.

usage.description: Usages restrict which usage filters can select this group.

value.description: Values restrict which loot value tiers can use this group.

MapPrototypeExport.description: MapPrototypeExport associates a model shape with the logical name used for its cluster prototype.

name.description: Name is the logical cluster group identifier referenced by prototype entries.

shape.description: Shape is the P3D model path whose terrain placements use this mapping.

MapPrototypeExports.description: MapPrototypeExports maps cluster model shapes to logical cluster group names used by CE.

export.description: Exports are the model-to-cluster mappings exported by the terrain.

MapPrototypePoint.description: MapPrototypePoint defines one candidate loot placement in a prototype's local model coordinates.

flags.description: Flags is the bitmask of CE placement behaviors enabled for this point.

height.description: Height is the vertical clearance available for an item at this point.

pos.description: Pos is the local X/Y/Z position relative to the model origin, not a map position.

range.description: Range is the placement radius around the point.

MapPrototypeProxy.description: MapPrototypeProxy defines one object created by a dynamic-event dispatch.

dechance.description: DEChance is the probability that this proxy is created by the dispatch.

pos.description: Pos is the object's position relative to the prototype.

rpy.description: RPY is the object's rotation relative to the prototype, in roll, pitch, yaw order.

type.description: Type is the game class name of the dispatched object.

NamedRef.description: NamedRef stores the name attribute used by CE reference elements such as usage, category, tag, value, type, and group.

name.description: Name is the identifier referenced by the containing CE element.
